module signal_generator (
    input clk, rst_n,
    output reg [4:0] wave
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    
    always@(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
        if(!rst_n) begin
            state <= 0;
            wave <= 0;
        end
        else begin
            case(state)
                0: begin
                    if(wave == 31) begin
                        state <= 1;
                    end
                    else begin
                        wave <= wave + 1;
                    end
                end
                1: begin
                    if(wave == 0) begin
                        state <= 0;
                    end
                    else begin
                        wave <= wave - 1;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end
    
endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="signal_generator">
    <description>Triangle Wave Signal Generator</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <output id="wave" width_description="[4:0]">5-bit output waveform signal representing the generated waveform.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="state">Register to store the current state of the waveform generation process.</parameter>
        <parameter id="wave">Register to represent the generated waveform signal.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="state" type="internal" width_description="[1:0]">Internal register to store the current state of the waveform generation process.</reg>
        <reg id="wave" type="internal" width_description="[4:0]">Internal register to represent the generated waveform signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State machine to generate triangle wave signal
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (~rst_n) begin
                state <= 0;
                wave <= 0;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    0: begin
                        if(wave == 31) begin
                            state <= 1;
                        end else begin
                            wave <= wave + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    1: begin
                        if(wave == 0) begin
                            state <= 0;
                        end else begin
                            wave <= wave - 1;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
